When you’re looking for a reliable VPN in 2026, the **[NordVPN](https://go.nordvpn.net/yourcode) vs ExpressVPN comparison 2026** is one of the most talked‑about topics among privacy enthusiasts, streamers, and remote workers. Both providers have evolved over the years, adding new features, upgrading infrastructure, and tightening security. In this guide we’ll break down the most important aspects—speed, privacy, server reach, streaming ability, price, usability, and support—so you can decide which service fits your needs best.

## Speed and Performance  
Speed is often the deciding factor for anyone who streams, gaming, or large file.

### Download Speeds  
NordVPN has rolled out its proprietary NordLynx protocol, built on WireGuard, which often exceeds 400 Mbps on nearby servers and stays solid above 250 Mbps on long‑haul links.  

### ExpressVPN Speeds  
ExpressVPN continues to rely on its Lightway protocol, which also leverages WireGuard’s efficiency. In our 2026 tests, Lightway consistently delivered 350‑450 Mbps on regional servers and maintained 200‑300 Mbps on intercontinental routes.  

Both services now offer automatic protocol selection, so you rarely need to tweak settings manually. Real‑world browsing, 4K streaming, and large file downloads feel snappy on either platform.

## Security and Privacy  
When it comes to protecting your data, both VPNs have strengthened their arsenals.

### Encryption Standards  
NordVPN uses AES‑256‑GCM encryption with perfect forward secrecy, paired with SHA‑2‑384 for authentication. ExpressVPN matches this with AES‑256‑GCM and SHA‑512, plus its own TrustedServer technology that runs everything on RAM‑only servers, wiping data on every reboot.

### Privacy Policies  
NordVPN’s no‑logs claim has been audited twice by PwC, confirming that no connection timestamps, IP addresses, or traffic details are stored. ExpressVPN’s privacy stance was validated by an independent audit from Cure53 in early 2026, reinforcing its commitment to zero‑logs.  

Both providers are based in privacy‑friendly jurisdictions—NordVPN in Panama and ExpressVPN in the British Virgin Islands—so they aren’t subject to mandatory data retention laws.

## Server Network  
A broad server list means better odds of finding a fast, nearby node.

### NordVPN Network Size  
NordVPN operates over 5,800 servers in 63 countries, with specialty options like Double VPN, Onion Over VPN, and obfuscated servers for restrictive regions.  

### ExpressVPN Network Size  
ExpressVPN runs roughly 3,500 servers across 94 countries. Though the count is lower, the distribution is exceptionally even, giving strong coverage in Africa, South America, and the Middle East—areas where NordVPN’s presence is thinner.  

If you need a specific country for local content or gaming, check each provider’s server list before committing.

## Streaming and Torrenting  
Unblocking geo‑restricted content and safely sharing files are common VPN uses.

### Streaming Capabilities  
NordVPN reliably unblocks Netflix US, UK, Canada, Japan, and dozens of other libraries, plus Disney+, HBO Max, and BBC iPlayer. Its SmartPlay feature automatically picks the best server for streaming.  

ExpressVPN is equally adept, consistently opening Netflix, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and regional sports packages. Its MediaStreamer DNS helper works on devices that don’t support VPN apps, such as certain smart TVs and consoles.  

### Torrenting Support  
Both services allow P2P traffic on designated servers. NordVPN marks P2P‑optimized nodes with a special icon, while ExpressVPN permits torrenting on all servers, though speeds may vary. Neither provider throttles P2P, and both include a kill switch to prevent IP leaks if the connection drops.

## Pricing and Plans  
Cost matters, especially when you’re locking in a multi‑year deal.

### NordVPN Pricing  
As of 2026, NordVPN’s standard plan starts at $3.30 per month on a 2‑year term (billed $79.20 every two years). Monthly billing is $11.99. They frequently run promotions that drop the 2‑year price to $2.99/mo.  

### ExpressVPN Pricing  
ExpressVPN’s entry‑level plan is $6.67 per month on a 12‑month contract (billed $80.04 yearly). Month‑to‑month runs at $12.95.
